title: Cozy Dual-Condo Retreat Near Downtown/Airport
description:
Perfect for groups up to 16! This unique two-condo combo in Southeast Nashville offers a stylish retreat with 4 bedrooms and 3.5 baths. Enjoy privacy and space while being just minutes from Nashville International Airport (BNA), Downtown, and Opryland. Ideal for large families, friends, or corporate travelers seeking convenience and comfort in Music City.

The space
Welcome to your Nashville headquarters, a unique combination of two separate, non-attached condos designed to comfortably host up to 16 guests. These bright, welcoming, and attractively decorated spaces are perfect for relaxation after a day of exploring Music City. The property features a total of 4 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms.

Bed & Bath Configuration:
*Unit 1*
* Bedroom 1: 1 Queen Bed with an en-suite Jack-and-Jill bathroom and walk-in closet.
* Bedroom 2: 1 Queen Bed, 1 Bunk Bed (Twin over Full), with an en-suite Jack-and-Jill bathroom and walk-in closet.

*Unit 2*
* Bedroom 1: 1 Queen Bed with an en-suite bathroom.
* Bedroom 2: 1 Queen Bed, 1 Bunk Bed (Twin over Twin), 1 Twin Trundle Bed, with an en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet.

Guest access
Guests will have full and private access to both entire condos. This includes all common areas, living rooms, fully equipped kitchens, bedrooms, bathrooms, and back porches. Convenient, reserved parking is available for up to four vehicles in uncovered spaces directly within the complex.

Other things to note
* Two Separate Units: Please be aware that this listing is for two separate, non-attached condo units.
* Noise Potential: The condo is located near railroad tracks and the airport, so you may experience some related noise during your stay.
* Shared Walls: This is a condo complex, and our unit shares one wall with an adjoining condo. You may occasionally hear creaks from the floor or water running through pipes.
* Decorative Fireplace: The fireplace is for ambiance only. Please do not burn anything in it.
* Starter Supplies: We provide a starter kit of supplies (toilet paper, paper towels, etc.) to begin your stay. Guests are responsible for any additional items needed.
* Liability: All listed amenities are to be used at the guest’s own risk. The homeowner is not liable for any risk, danger, injury, or damages.
